description: OFAC sanctions screening for a company or person name (fuzzy, aliases included) and/or a crypto wallet address, e.g. a counterparty or payTo wallet before paying it. Checked against the US Treasury OFAC SDN list (names plus 1,000+ listed wallets), refreshed daily. Returns match / possible_match / no_match with the listed entries and programs. Refuses rather than answers if the list is stale. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="sanctions_screen".

address.description: Crypto wallet address to screen (any chain OFAC lists)

name.description: Person or company name to screen

type.description: Optional: only match this SDN type (individual, entity, vessel, aircraft)
